open_region: Hadronic (non-muon-rich) SUEP with dark-meson/dark-photon ctau ~1 mm - O(10 cm): every SUEP search (CMS ggF, scouting, WH/ZH; ATLAS muons) assumes prompt decays and builds multiplicity only from PV-associated tracks, so displaced soft tracks are lost; emerging-jet searches need energetic jets and heavy (>~600 GeV) mediators; CMS displaced-dimuon HV search covers the muon-rich displaced case only; MDS covers metre-scale ctau. Open: low/intermediate mediator (125 GeV-~1 TeV) isotropic displaced-track multiplicity. Also no official CMS/ATLAS HL-LHC SUEP projection found (only truth-level Snowmass trigger study, prompt). Pair-produced/non-resonant SUEP: no experimental search found.
